name: swajp
summary: Portfolio of a Czech full stack developer: a project case study, featured projects, about and blog.
description: Personal site of Miroslav Stejskal (swajp), a full stack developer based in the Czech Republic. It presents a project study — a complete redesign of uzx-elektro/uzx-security built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui from a Figma design — plus featured projects such as an AI resume creator, 'Place of amazing portfolios' and devkoutek.cz, alongside an about page and a blog.
